description: Update editable fields on a DRAFT invoice (notes, internal notes, payment terms, payment instructions, due date, purchase order number). Only valid while the invoice is still a Draft.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

internal_notes.description: Internal notes (not on the printed invoice).

invoice_id.description: Id of the draft invoice to update.

notes.description: Notes to appear on the invoice.

payment_instructions.description: Bank / payment instructions for the customer.

purchase_order_number.description: Customer PO number to reference on the invoice.

name: update_draft_invoice
